Package org.geysermc.paletter.block.component

Record Class RedstoneProducer

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.block.component.RedstoneProducer
Record Components:
connectedFaces - The list of faces that are considered connected to the circuit. If a face is not connected, it will not provide power to the block touching that face. By default, all faces are connected. Add-on JSON connected_faces. Default: ["down","up","north","south","west","east"]. Compiled by the hand transform face_list.
power - The strength of the redstone signal produced by this block. Valid values are from 0 to 15, where 0 means no signal and 15 is the maximum signal strength. Value must be <= 15. Add-on JSON power. Required. Range [0, 15] (docs).
stronglyPoweredFace - The block touching this face will become strongly powered with the signal level strength of 'power'. The block touching this face will become strongly powered with the signal level strength of 'power'. Strongly powered blocks will power adjacent blocks. By default, the block will not strongly power any face. Add-on JSON strongly_powered_face. Optional (null: not set).
transformRelative - If true, the strongly_powered_face and connected_faces properties will be rotated according to the 'minecraft:transformation' component. Add-on JSON transform_relative. Optional (null: not set). The docs give the default false, but BDS sends minecraft:redstone_producer.transform_relative = 1 (byte) when it is omitted; so it is unset by default, and the encoder sends what BDS sends then.
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockComponent
@BedrockFormat("1.21.120") public record RedstoneProducer(@NonNull List<RedstoneProducer.ConnectedFaces> connectedFaces, int power, @Nullable RedstoneProducer.StronglyPoweredFace stronglyPoweredFace, @Nullable Boolean transformRelative) extends Record implements BlockComponent
If added to a block, indicates that it produces a redstone signal.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:redstone_producer".

Since:
1.0.0
